lines.zh: 我一步一步走，脚把地压陷。
lines.en: I walk step by step, the ground denting.

lines.zh: 炉口的火随我的步子一明一暗。
lines.en: The furnace mouth flickers with each step.
I walk slowly and never change course.
My arms swing like iron columns.

lines.zh: 脚下的草被烤得卷起来。
lines.en: The grass curls and scorches underfoot.
I walk toward you for no other reason.

lines.zh: 身体里煤炭烧得噼啪响。
lines.en: Coal crackles inside my chest.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，都有灰落下来。
lines.en: Ash falls with every step.

lines.zh: 我绕不过去，就直接碾过去。
lines.en: I don't go around; I go through.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都卷了边。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass curls at the edges.

lines.zh: 铁皮在关节处磨得发响。
lines.en: Iron plates grind at my joints.
I lift a leg and drop it hard.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，因为我不会累。
lines.en: My gait is steady because I don't tire.

lines.zh: 烟火从我肩缝里飘出去。
lines.en: Smoke leaks from my shoulder seams.
I stand, furnace burning in my chest.

lines.zh: 我站着，听自己的火慢慢烧。
lines.en: I stand and listen to my own fire burn.
Firelight shifts in my eyes.
I wait for you to come closer.
Cinders drop at my feet.
My head turns slowly.
There's still fire under the iron.

lines.zh: 炉膛里噼啪一声，我侧了侧头。
lines.en: A crackle in my grate; I tilt my head.
I've baked this ground dry.

lines.zh: 我听不见风声，只听见火。
lines.en: I hear no wind, only fire.

lines.zh: 我低头，看着自己的手掌。
lines.en: I look down at my palm.
There's a layer of black ash in it.
I'm not going to move.
The heat is just right.

lines.zh: 我低下头，火光正照着你。
lines.en: I lower my head, firelight falling on you.
You stand before me, far too short.
My eyes are two furnace mouths.

lines.zh: 我烤着你的护甲，你还没发觉。
lines.en: I'm heating your armor and you haven't noticed.

lines.zh: 我把头歪了一点，铁皮响。
lines.en: I tilt my head and the iron creaks.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，炉门的缝对着你。
lines.en: I tilt my head, the grate's seam aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我在看你手里那件东西。
lines.en: I'm looking at what's in your hand.
The furnace door opens and shuts.
You blink, and I'm two blocks closer.
You speak; I hear only fire.
My shadow is hotter than I am.
Stand still and let me see you.
A dent is punched into my plate.
I don't cry out, only throw sparks.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，脚陷进土里。
lines.en: I step back and my foot sinks in.
The fire in my chest dims.

lines.zh: 我用指节敲了敲裂开的地方。
lines.en: I rap my knuckles on the split plate.
A shard of iron falls off.
I hold and reset my weight.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，炉灰簌簌往下掉。
lines.en: I sway; ash sifts down off my frame.
The fire catches again.

lines.zh: 我的铁皮凹了一块，火没灭。
lines.en: A plate on me is dented, but my fire still burns.
Is that coal? I smell it.
Iron will do too. I'm not picky.

lines.zh: 你举着的那块，黑得发亮。
lines.en: That piece you hold is black and glinting.

lines.zh: 你手里的煤，扔进我胸口。
lines.en: Toss the coal you're holding into my chest.
Drop it in and I'll leave.
That's barely enough fuel for a while.

lines.zh: 给我煤，别拿草来糊弄我。
lines.en: Give me coal, not grass.
The fire is dying. Hurry.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的东西，别收回去。
lines.en: I'm watching it. Don't put it away.

lines.zh: 你给，我就收；不给，我就拿。
lines.en: Give it and I take it. Don't, and I take it anyway.

lines.zh: 铁皮响了一声，我还在原地。
lines.en: The plate rings once; I haven't moved.

lines.zh: 铁皮把冲击弹回你身上。
lines.en: The iron throws the impact back at you.

lines.zh: 我拍了拍那块，把凹痕按平。
lines.en: I pat the spot and press the dent flat.
That felt hot, didn't it?

lines.zh: 你撞上我，弹回去的却是你。
lines.en: You hit me, yet it's you who bounces.
You stumble back several steps.
I crush the grass to ash.
I have no reason to step aside.

lines.zh: 你撞我的炉壁，力道弹回去
lines.en: You hit my furnace wall; the force bounces back.
Your bones are much softer than iron.
There's no kin here. Only the fire.
I've stood a long time and nothing came.
Iron golems don't talk to each other.
If there were another furnace, perhaps.
I listen to my own fire.
The sound is monotonous.
I press a hand to my chest. Hot.
No answer.

lines.zh: 没有回应的火，我自己烧。
lines.en: No answering flame; I burn alone.
Waiting is also a kind of burning.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，关节一路咔响。
lines.en: I bend down, joints clicking the whole way.
Iron fingers can't grip small things.
I lift the whole thing.
Good coal. I'll keep it.
I push it into my chest furnace.
The fire burns brighter.
Wood burns too, just too fast.
I toss the stone aside.
A black mark stays on my palm.
Anything burnable, I take.
You moved; I turn my head.
The furnace fire surges.

lines.zh: 我开合两下炉门，就你了。
lines.en: I swing my grate twice: you.

lines.zh: 我一步比一步快，地都在抖。
lines.en: Each step faster than the last; the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 你身后的墙，是我留给你的。
lines.en: That wall behind you, I saved it for you.

lines.zh: 我的炉火窜高，这事就定了。
lines.en: My furnace flares; that settles it.

lines.zh: 你穿着铁，我隔着墙都听见。
lines.en: You're wearing iron; I hear it through the wall.
I raise a hand before the step.

lines.zh: 火从我的指缝里冒出来。
lines.en: Fire escapes between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我的头转得慢，但我不转身。
lines.en: My head turns slowly, but I never turn my back.

lines.zh: 我先看你的脚，再看你的路。
lines.en: I look at your feet first, then where you can run.
You'll fall first.
There's no other target here.
You'll do.
You circle; I circle.

lines.zh: 你听得见我的脚步，躲不掉。
lines.en: You can hear my steps; you can't dodge them.

lines.zh: 你的箭打在我身上，只留白点。
lines.en: Your arrows leave only pale marks.

lines.zh: 我把火压进炉膛，走得更沉。
lines.en: I bank my fire low and walk heavier.
The grass is scorched behind me.

lines.zh: 你躲在柱子后，我就撞柱子。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar; I hit the pillar.
The pillar is falling.
I raise a hand and flame sweeps out.
Your routes are narrowing.
I don't need to see; I hear you.
My plates glow red.

lines.zh: 你退得越远，我烧得越久。
lines.en: The further you retreat, the longer I burn.

lines.zh: 这一圈跑完，你就没地方了。
lines.en: One more lap and there's nowhere left.
Come on. No more hiding.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地面凹了。
lines.en: My fist falls and the ground dents.
My arm sweeps you aside.
I seize you, palm searing.
This blow carries furnace heat.
I slam you to the ground.
Fire jets between my fingers.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，护甲烧红了。
lines.en: You block, and your armor glows red.

lines.zh: 我这一拳落下，地面裂了一圈。
lines.en: My fist comes down; the ground cracks in a ring.
You retreat; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 这一击不为杀你，只为推开。
lines.en: This blow isn't to kill, only to shove.
My plate cracks. I don't care.
The fire still burns.
You're still up. Again.
My fists are not light.

lines.zh: 我从一堆熄灭的炉渣里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from a heap of dead cinders.

lines.zh: 胸口的第一把火烧起来了。
lines.en: The first fire lights in my chest.
Furnace ash still clings to my plates.
I raise a hand and the joints crack.
The ground around me dries out.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，胸口就有一团火。
lines.en: When I woke, a fire was already in my chest.
I only know I must burn.
The grass underfoot begins to curl.

lines.zh: 炉口一亮，我朝你转过头。
lines.en: My grate glows; I turn my head toward you.
Smoke first, then me.
The fire drowns out everything.

lines.zh: 我迈出第一步，草就干了。
lines.en: I take my first step and the grass dries.

lines.zh: 我站起来，身上的渣子往下掉。
lines.en: I rise, slag dropping off my shoulders.
It's too damp here.
Fire is just more fuel to me.

lines.zh: 我砸下去，地面裂了一圈。
lines.en: I land and the ground cracks in a ring.

lines.zh: 水浇进炉膛，我的火差点灭。
lines.en: Water floods my furnace; my fire nearly dies.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的铁皮掀开一角。
lines.en: The blast peels a corner of my plate open.
An arrow sticks in my plate like a pin.

lines.zh: 符文爬上铁皮，火被压住了。
lines.en: Runes crawl over my plates and smother the fire.

lines.zh: 没有燃料，炉膛越来越冷。
lines.en: No fuel; my furnace grows cold.

lines.zh: 雷顺着铁皮走，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my plates and I go numb.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，炉火在风里乱晃。
lines.en: I fall, and the fire gutters in the wind.
